title: crotalaria incana subsp. purpurascens
intro: Crotalaria incana subsp. purpurascens, commonly known as the purple leaf rattlebox, is a plant species that belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). The health benefits of Crotalaria incana subsp. purpurascens include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antispasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Crotalaria incana subsp. purpurascens, and its bioactive constituents, including purpurin, which is a unique anthraquinone derivative.
